Name: The Northern Gulf
Author: Charost
AuthorLabel: The commission of The Northern Gulf
Description:
[center][size=6][b]English translation are finishing now![/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Even though this mod already has its unique features, it's still a bit far from what we ultimately envisioned, and we will continue to refine it![/size][/b]
[b][size=4]尽管这个mod已经有了它的独特之处，但与我们最终的设想还有一定的差距，我们将继续完善它！[/size][/b]

[size=6][b]English[/b][/size][spoiler]
[size=5][b]New NPCs[/b][/size]
[size=3]Now we add 12 new NPCs in this mod and there are 2 cute animal in it!
We've brought the richness of their experience to light and will more interesting and rich in the future![/size]

[size=5][b]Diffierent Development[/b][/size]
[size=3]Enjoying the salas or the BBQ in the village is decided to you![/size]
[size=3]Both now and in the future, we will involve players in the development of The Northern Gulf as much as possible![/size]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Not only SVE but also RSV and so on can be added with this mod and can work together![/size]
[size=3]Of course, our considerations and testing may be lacking to the extent that a portion of the mod isn't compatible, but we haven't found that yet. [/size]
[size=3]If you find mods that are not compatible with TNG, feel free to give feedback![/size]
[size=3](This mod add a new map on the northern of the BusStop,﻿You can see if the mod you've added also adds a map north of BusStop to determine compatibility!)[/size]

[size=5][b]For the player[/b][/size]
[size=3]We, the developers, are always thinking of ways to immerse players into this casual game.[/size]
[size=3]In the end, we chose to diversify the dialogue options of NPCs and allow player to decide how the town will develop. All of this is to make an enjoyable and appealing mod, whether it is in the early game where players are busy earning money or in the late game where the game becomes more laid back. [/size]

[size=5][b]Contacting with us﻿[/b][/size]
[size=3]Discord's invitation code: [b]https://discord.gg/t8F7bpge[/b] (non-scheduled update)
We do not intend to open up contact details on other platforms as it is difficult for us to access them and we are not familiar with how to use them.[/size]

[size=5][b]The future about this mod[/b][/size]
Unless there are bugs to fix, 1.0.4 is the final version of SDV 1.5.
We will still try our best to make this mod in SDV 1.6.And a bad news is that we won't update this mod to 1.6 in time when SDV 1.6 is published.
We will add more events and dialogues in the future,and you can become more immersed in The Northern Gulf and its development decisions in the future!

[size=5][b]For the mod authors who want to edit this mod[/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]If you have changed the data for this mod and wish to release it, you must contact [b]The commission of The Northern Gulf[/b] and you must clearly label [b]the data that you has been cut[/b].Otherwise, we will treat it as an infringement of copyright.[/size][/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[b][size=6]Chinese[/size][/b][spoiler]
[size=5][b]新的NPC[/b][/size]
[size=3]目前我们添加了12个NPC，其中包括2只可爱的吉祥物！
未来我们将让他们的人物特色更加饱满与丰富。[/size]

[size=5][b]不同的发展方向[/b][/size]
[size=3]是为村庄添加一个沙拉摊还是一个烧烤架全部取决于你！
无论是现在还是将来，我们都将让玩家更加沉浸在北部湾和决定其发展中！[/size]

[size=5][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
[size=3]北部湾与已知的大部分扩展mod包括SVE和RSV在内兼容！
当然，由于我们并不一定会涉猎所有mod，所有可能依旧有一些mod与北部湾并不兼容。如果你发现了，欢迎反馈！
（这个mod在BusStop北部添加了一个新地图，所以你可以通过观察其它mod是否也在相同的位置添加了一个地图来初步判断是否兼容！）[/size]

[size=5][b]对于玩家[/b][/size]
[size=3]我们经常在想如何让玩家沉浸在这个休闲游戏中。
最终我们选择通过丰富NPC的对话并将决定村庄发展的方向的权力给予玩家。并制作一个无论是沉迷于赚钱的前期还是休闲的后期都对玩家有着足够吸引力的mod！
禁止在除Nexusmods以外的任何软件或者网址提供本mod的下载源文件，包括BiliBili，百度网盘，淘宝等网店等等[/size]

[size=5][b]联系我们[/b][/size]
[size=3]北部湾交流群：248242429[/size]

[size=5][b]北部湾的未来[/b][/size]
[size=3]除非1.0.4有错误需要修复，否则1.0.4为星露谷物语1.5的最终版本。
在星露谷物语1.6中，我们会继续尽最大的努力制作北部湾。不过，一个坏消息是，我们无法与1.6同步更新。
在未来我们将会添加更多的事件和更多的人物对话，并让玩家发现北部湾更多有趣的地方！[/size]

[size=5][b]对于想要更改本mod数据的mod作者[/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]如果你想发布你更改过北部湾(The Northern Gulf)数据的mod，你必须联系[b]北部湾制作组[/b]以获取许可。
如果有，注明北部湾在[b]你的mod中被删减的数据[/b]。（不要求注明添加的数据）[/size][/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[b][size=6]Languages Localization[/size][/b][spoiler]
[b][size=3]Sending me private messages in Nexus rather than commenting in Posts which I may forget or neglect to connect with you!!![/size][/b]
[size=3]You also can join our server in [b]Discord[/b] and then tell us you want to help us.
Of course, we suggest you choice the second way.Because the reason why you connect with us in [b]Nexus[/b] in the first way is inviting you to join in our server.[/size]
[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Possible Problems[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install this mod will lead to that SDV can't load your archiving.(Prolonged black screen, known to last more than 7 minutes at most)[/size]
[*][size=3]Some NPCs in RSV have changed paths as a result of this mod, which may cause some minor errors.[/size]
[/list]
